recognize_zh: 九格組圖的周邊血抹片：低倍（A）在抹片羽狀邊緣即可見多個大細胞；高倍可見被原始細胞包圍、核圓深染的小型巨核細胞（micromegakaryocyte，B、C）、核分離成多個圓形核的發育異常巨核細胞（D–H）以及包入血球的 emperipolesis（I）；周邊血中出現巨核細胞與小型巨核細胞，提示伴巨核細胞異常的急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Panel A (low power): numerous large cells aligned along the feathered edge of the peripheral blood smear
Panels B-C: micromegakaryocytes, small cells with a single dense round nucleus and scant cytoplasm with adherent platelet blebs, admixed with blasts
Panels D, G, H: dysplastic megakaryocytes with multiple widely separated, round nuclei ('pawn ball' pattern) and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm
Panels E-F: megakaryocytes with hypolobated or clustered nuclei and cytoplasmic budding of platelets
Panel I: megakaryocyte showing emperipolesis of hematopoietic cells, with adjacent platelet clumps
Background of numerous red cells with scattered blasts; Auer rods not resolvable at this resolution
describe_en: This composite of peripheral blood smear images shows circulating megakaryocytic elements in a patient with a marked blast leukocytosis. At low power (A), multiple large cells are concentrated at the feathered edge. Higher-power panels show micromegakaryocytes with a single dense round nucleus and scant cytoplasm with platelet budding admixed with blasts (B, C), dysplastic megakaryocytes with multiple separated round nuclei or hypolobated nuclei (D-H), and emperipolesis of hematopoietic cells (I). Image resolution limits evaluation of blast cytology and Auer rods. The findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with megakaryocytic dysplasia; bone marrow examination with immunophenotyping (CD41/CD61) and cytogenetics is recommended to evaluate for myelodysplasia-related changes or megakaryoblastic differentiation.

ddx.dx: Primary myelofibrosis or other MPN with circulating megakaryocytes
ddx.vs: MPNs may release megakaryocytes and nuclei into blood but show a leukoerythroblastic picture with teardrop cells and a low blast percentage, not 94% blasts.

In AMKL the blasts themselves show megakaryocytic lineage (cytoplasmic blebs, CD41/CD61+) in at least 50% of blasts, whereas here dysplastic megakaryocytes accompany a blast population that must be phenotyped.
MDS shows similar micromegakaryocytes and separated nuclei but with blasts below 20%, whereas this patient has overt leukemic blasts.

ddx.dx: Circulating tumor cells or blasts mimicking megakaryocytes
ddx.vs: Tumor cells form cohesive clusters without platelet budding, while megakaryocytes show platelet blebs, emperipolesis and CD61 positivity.
